name: Ray of Hope (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, mesmerist 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You shoot a ray of softly-glowing energy causing hope to well up in the subject. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack against the target to affect them, though the target may choose to forgo their Dexterity bonus to AC. If you hit, the target gains a +2 morale bonus on saves, attack rolls, ability checks and skill checks.
